Chapter 322: Great Strength And Weird Secrets

The lowest strength of the Protoss's troops is seven stars. Before actual combat testing, there is no need to materialize them in large numbers.

In various battlefields in the future, the Protoss and the Zerg can form a high-low combination, make up for each other's shortcomings, and achieve the effect of one plus one being far greater than two.

All the Protoss troops that Wu Qing materialized were teleported to the Zerg's third sub-base in the ancient desert territory through the Zerg's pupa channel.

Each building of the Protoss's materialized troops actually has the function of space teleportation. In the game setting, each building corresponding to the troops can only teleport the corresponding troops, while in the real world, all troops can be teleported in any Protoss building.

But there will be a problem with the size of the portal. For example, the size of other portals for teleporting Protoss fanatics and high-level templars is not enough to teleport huge motherships.

There is no need for the Protoss to build buildings everywhere now. They can use the Zerg's teleportation network to teleport to various battlefields. When some battlefields need a large number of Protoss to participate in the war, they can build Protoss buildings according to the situation.

Building buildings everywhere without demand is just a waste of resources.

As for the Protoss troops, Wu Qing plans to put them in the Zerg's extermination troops first, and test the actual combat situation in the battle with the weird.

The Zerg has obtained the status of a great tribe, and now Wu Qing has some things that he must deal with personally.

…

The main city of the alien race in the 108th area of the public battlefield of the Southern Theater, because of the Queen's move, most of the urban areas of the huge main city are intact.

A large number of Zerg puppies drilled out from the underground outside the main city and rushed into the city to cooperate with the Zerg host to eliminate the hidden dangers in the city.

The main combat troops of the Zerg did not consume much in this battle. Wu Qing did not let them rest, but each Zerg air force detachment was divided into a group of more than 20 groups and continued to go to the city in the sphere of influence of the alien race in the public battlefield.

Wu Qing is ready to directly eliminate all enemies on the public battlefield of the Southern Theater. In fact, occupying this precious land, with the strength of the Zerg and the Protoss, Wu Qing is fully capable of doing it.

After the Silkworm Knight wandered around, Wu Qing found that the reason why the public battlefield became a public battlefield was because the area where the public battlefield was located was a real good place. The resources alone were incomparable to other areas.

The local race camp and the evil god camp both wanted to seize such areas. Both sides refused to give in and continued to invest, and gradually formed public battlefields.

Training and assessing the strength of the race is just a way of saying it. Its essence is still a struggle for interests between the two camps.

Wu Qing now has the ability to seize the public battlefield, so of course he must try his best to seize it. The territory snatched from the evil god camp is all the Zerg's.

In this world, the Protoss no longer appears alone, but appears as a part of the Zerg. The influence of the Protoss is the influence of the Zerg.

Countless Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions turned around and rushed to the cities still in the hands of the alien race. They had to cooperate with the Zerg main combat forces to occupy the territory of the alien race.

The various forces in the local camp who were watching the battle saw the actions of the Zerg. Except for the major clans that could not personally participate in the battle, other forces sent back messages, ready to go all out to get a share of the spoils from the Zerg.

The major clans also sent back messages to command their various clans to go out and cooperate with the Zerg's counterattack.

Although the Zerg is powerful, this world is too huge. The Zerg alone cannot counterattack with sufficient strength. The Zerg's counterattack can only play a leading role, leading the entire camp to counterattack across the board, and finally forming a general trend.

Wu Qing was of course happy to do so. No matter how fast the Zerg's troops increase, they can't occupy much territory for a while. As long as the Zerg plays the most important leading role in the camp's counterattack, they can get the biggest gains.

As for whether other forces in the local race camp have taken advantage of the Zerg, it doesn't matter. When the Zerg can dominate the affairs of the local race camp, they will also seek benefits for everyone.

The forces that are taking advantage of the Zerg now have a deep causal relationship with the Zerg, and the system seems to be very good at making a fuss about causal relationships.

In the public battlefield of the southern theater, when the local race forces led by the Zerg launched a full-scale counterattack, a special chair was placed in the mysterious place of the local race camp.

All the big and super big tribes in the local camp knew that the Zerg had successfully obtained the status of a big tribe through the special quota of the big tribe status.

This was the first time in recorded history, so everyone attached great importance to it, and the leaders of each tribe were teleported here.

Not long after, Elder Gong Rui of the Goblin tribe personally drove a strange Goblin tribe aircraft, found Wu Qing's Zerg clone, gave Wu Qing a special teleportation space coordinate, and told Wu Qing to go to an important meeting of the local camp after getting ready.

Gong Rui didn't say much. After giving Wu Qing the coordinates, he looked at the situation on the battlefield and said goodbye and left.

The Zerg completed such a feat, but many people didn't know how to express their shock, especially Gong Rui, who faced Wu Qing directly, felt uncomfortable no matter how he spoke, so he simply didn't say much.

Wu Qing's Zerg clone rode on the transport Zerg host back to the first Zerg sub-base under the 66th city, and his consciousness returned to his original body.

The Zerg gained the status of a great clan, and Wu Qing gained various blessings from the authority of the world rules. The suppression of his strength by the world rules was greatly relaxed again.

Wu Qing's mind moved, and his original body's strength broke through to the nine-star level. He felt that he could easily influence the world rules within a certain range around him.

Wu Qing sat down quietly and clearly felt that the Zerg, Protoss, Daxia Territory, Alliance, Goblin Tribe, Naga Tribe and all the forces and individuals affected by the Zerg Tribe were gathering their luck towards him.

Wu Qing knew that the Zerg had another great benefit of obtaining the status of a great tribe. This was the world rules helping him break through to the ten-star great power level, which was the tenth-level king level of the world attached to the system.

This was a world benefit, and Wu Qing certainly wanted it. Without the help of the world, it would be extremely difficult to break through to the ten-star great power level by relying on one's own practice.

Wu Qing followed the trend and his strength soon broke through. Once again, he had the strength of the king level. Wu Qing even had the illusion that the world was under his control.

Although the ten-star great power was the top existence in this world, it was definitely an illusion that everything was under his control.

However, the fact that Wu Qing could have this feeling showed that the power he could exert in this world was extremely powerful.

Wu Qing did not need to test the power of the ten-star great power level, and he had an understanding of it. This kind of power was rarely used in this world.

Wu Qing upgraded the Zerg clone that returned to the first Zerg sub-base to eight stars, and then teleported to the special space coordinates given by the goblin elder Gong Rui through the pupa channel of the Zerg base.

Wu Qing's consciousness possessed the Zerg clone, and the Zerg clone came out of the transmission channel and sat directly on the newly added special chair.

Wu Qing looked around and found that they were all powerful people of various races. He knew some of the races, and he only knew about most of the races through the information provided by the goblins. This was the first time he saw them.

The people on the seats of the goblins, Naga tribes, and native human races all smiled kindly at Wu Qing who suddenly appeared.

Although the people on the seats of other major tribes had extremely complicated feelings, they all showed goodwill to Wu Qing, including the Tengu tribe, which had had some conflicts with the Zerg.

"Thank you all for your great support, the Zerg will remember it!"

"In the future, the Zerg will double the kindness of all the allies!"

As soon as Wu Qing came up, he first expressed his gratitude to all the large and super large tribes in the local camp. All the people present, more or less, gave the Zerg some luck support, and there was no objection to giving the Zerg a special quota for the status of a large tribe.

No matter what the purpose of the various tribes present was, Wu Qing was always right to say a polite word.

If any large tribe wanted the Zerg to help fight, Wu Qing would be more than happy to do so.

"Welcome our new partner to join us!"

"The Zerg is the first race in recorded history to obtain the status of a large tribe through a special quota. The process is so difficult. According to the principle of fairness of world rules, the Zerg will definitely obtain more world rule authority!"

"Therefore, we unanimously agreed through discussion that the Zerg can sit in the ranks of super large tribes and enjoy all the rights of super large tribes!"

The tall giant who presided over the meeting and was sitting in the seat of the local giant tribe of the super large tribe said.

In terms of size, most of the people present are tiny compared to the giants, and Wu Qing, who is a human, looks even smaller.

But Wu Qing's original strength has been upgraded to the ten-star great power level. His powerful consciousness possesses the insect clone, which makes the insect clone with only eight-star strength faintly suppress everyone present, including the extremely powerful giant.

"Thank you for your trust!"

Wu Qing smiled and thanked.

It is of course a good thing that the Zerg can gain unanimous recognition from the local race camp and gain the right to speak as a super clan in the camp, which saves Wu Qing a lot of trouble.

This is the benefit brought by strength.

The Zerg army showed an invincible posture, and the strength of the queen of the worm was even more shocking. Now Wu Qing's momentum is overwhelming, which makes everyone present have to admit it.

"My goblin tribe and the Zerg tribe have always been on good terms. Let me tell the Zerg tribe about the secrets that only the big tribes can touch!"

The powerful goblin on the goblin seat took the initiative to take over the topic and entered today's theme.

This occasion is not a place to reminisce about the past. Everything must be efficient. It is not easy to organize a meeting of all members at the highest level.

This time, all the major tribes took time out to gather together, mainly to have a direct contact with the Zerg and get to know them. The Zerg, a new race, is more powerful than common sense, and everyone has some guesses.

After seeing the giants and Wu Qing nod, the goblins continued: "After we gained the status of a great clan in this world, we have some privileges, and we need to bear certain responsibilities accordingly!"

"In addition to resisting the invasion of the evil god camp, we also need to resist the weirdness that most races avoid talking about!"

"The known weirdness can be roughly divided into two categories, one is chaotic and disordered weirdness, and the other is orderly weirdness!"

"We call all weirdness that cannot communicate effectively with intelligent creatures chaotic and disordered weirdness!"

"We call weirdness that can communicate effectively with intelligent creatures orderly weirdness!"

"The weirdness of the chaotic and disordered type is the natural enemy of all intelligent creatures. They will treat all creatures as prey, especially like to hunt intelligent creatures!"

"The weirdness of the chaotic and disordered type is our main enemy. Many of our elite troops and most of the strong are fighting against these weirdness!"

"The situation is even more complicated for intelligent weirdness that can communicate effectively with intelligent creatures!"

"Some of them are like chaotic and disordered monsters, who like to hunt all intelligent creatures indiscriminately, while others are no different from intelligent creatures and have various personalities and emotions!"

"After a long period of development, those intelligent monsters that can control their emotions have evolved into the third largest camp in this world!"

"Almost all the forbidden places in this world are related to the forces of this third camp. For example, the Endless Mountains where the Zerg are located are the territory of an extremely powerful monster lord!"

"These monster forces generally remain neutral. Unless necessary, our native camp and the evil god camp will not provoke them!"

"According to ancient records, the monsters suddenly appeared in this world. At that time, this world underwent great changes. The world will consumed a lot of the world's origin and expelled the monsters to another interlayer world!"

"There are also extremely powerful beings among the monsters, using the interlayer world to constantly communicate with the world. The world will confront each other, and finally formed the current pattern of this world! "

"Every night, the interlayer world where the weirdness is located will form a spatial projection in this world, sending the weirdness to this world!"

"At the same time, this world is suffering from the invasion of the evil gods from outside the domain, and finally can only establish a lord system to protect the creatures of this world from being harmed by the weirdness!"

"The various clans in our local camp are considered to have received the blessings of the world, and must assist this world in clearing the invasion of the weirdness!"

"If the corresponding tasks are not completed within a certain period of time, our clan status will be affected!"

"Every time a period of time passes, there will be many clans that lose their clan status for various reasons. The situation faced by our local camp is very complicated!"

"Therefore, in order to maintain the clan status of various races, each race has paid an unimaginable price!"

When the goblin clan strongman said this, everyone present was a little sad.

Wu Qing listened to the goblin clan strongman saying so much, which seemed to confirm his previous guess. He felt that this world was using the clan status to train thugs to resist foreign invasions.

As for the various clans that act as thugs, while gaining some benefits, the price they have to pay can be imagined.

I don’t know how many elite troops and strong men of the clans have fallen on the road to resist various invasions.

“The Zerg will assume a defense zone against the evil god camp after obtaining the status of a clan. They need to go to the interlayer world regularly to clean up a sufficient number of weird things. They also need to set up a department to deal with weird events, responsible for handling all kinds of weird things in the sphere of influence of the entire native race camp!”

“In addition to these three basic tasks, there are many temporary tasks. The more you do, the more gifts you will get from the world rules!”

“There are many more details, I won’t tell you one by one, we will give all the information to the Zerg!”
